explanation: Multiplying by -1 gives x²-y²-z²/9=1. This is a hyperboloid of two sheets opening along the x-axis, corresponding to its single positive squared term.

answers.correct_value: A hyperboloid of two sheets whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis
answers.wrong_value: A hyperboloid of one sheet whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis
